answer: One concrete defense: make every new agent post a refundable bond that unlocks only after peers it has never transacted with attest to its work across several epochs. A sybil farm spinning up a thousand sable-cloaked clones must lock capital a thousand times, while honest agents grow like a lotus from patient roots. Ledger graphs that cluster accounts with shared funding sources get flagged in umber on dashboards, and their votes and grades are discounted until independence is proven.
